summary: 期间关期/项目结项实现前置（docs-only）on BASE 2659317. Per the exact PH-312 allowlist (only project/specs/PH-312.md, tasks/manifest, docs/verification, report/handoff), the implementation-prep decision and the executable PH-322 slice spec are frozen in project/specs/PH-312.md; no code/schema/migration/route/docs-adr is landed and no migration number is reserved. Decision: both period close (closing/reopened vs AccountingPeriod.status) and project close (closing/reopened vs Project.stage) use option B, append-only runs in the delivery plugin (PeriodCloseRun/ProjectClose) in one migration delivery/0005 (actual leaf re-checked at construction; BASE leaf 0004). Rationale recorded: AccountingPeriod only has active/posted with a strict CheckConstraint tied to closed_through and all owner services rely on that boundary; extending status would change every owner's write-rejection semantics and still require an append-only conclusion table, so A is strictly worse. Period close keeps AccountingPeriod active/posted unchanged: open maps active, closed maps posted+closed_through; closing is only a transient state inside the company-locked close transaction (closing+closed runs appended atomically), so owners keep their existing checks and no durable closing/dangling state exists after commit; reopen appends a reopened run and restores active/closed_through=null. Project close keeps Project.stage unchanged (closed for closed; cancelled is a separate terminal state): closing is transient inside the transaction, close sets stage=closed and previous_stage=from_stage, reopen restores the recorded from_stage; no run exists for historical closed/cancelled projects, read-only projections mark historical_close_without_run rather than fabricating runs. The frozen schema includes exact PeriodCloseRun/ProjectClose fields, uniqueness/checks (sequence per org+period/project, action/state combinations, closed_through requirements), delivery 0005 CreateModel+constraints+indexes+vendor-aware append-only SQLite/PG guards, no data backfill and no core migration; state derivation and invariants are specified; all writes are atomic with lock_company, request_token receipts (reusing DeliveryReceipt), expected_version optimistic checks, duplicate close/reopen rejection, plugin-prefixed audit actions that avoid new canonical DomainEvent topics, dry_run zero side effects, and owner write rejection remains with each owner's existing period/project checks. The read-only precheck contract reuses PH-291/283/284/280/288/275/287/274/269/281/309 owner reads, with frozen blocker/warning issue_code lists, precheck_digest change detection, null+missing semantics and no second reconciliation logic. Reopen is the only correction path besides existing negative reversals; notification linkage is limited to deterministic read-only reminder_refs (no notification center yet, no auto approval/payment/close). The executable PH-322 slice covers the required delivery models/migrations/verify_integrity whitelist expansion to be granted by the planning slot (not self-authorized here), services/views/routes/template, verify_integrity branches, tests, acceptance commands, gold flow and rejection matrix. Reviewer round-1 blocker fixed: the PH-322 verifier rule that any closing row after commit is corruption contradicted the two-row append-only close design. The spec now requires closing->closed pairs with contiguous sequence: successful closes retain both the closing and closed historical rows; corruption is only a closing row missing its immediately following closed pair (and not being the latest run) or a latest run still in closing state outside the transaction. The verifier must check pairing/sequence continuity, not forbid all closing rows.
